$description: Semantic layer. Every token here is a decision, expressed as a reference to a base primitive. The one declared exception is shadow geometry (offset, blur, spread), whose single home is this file. Re-point a base primitive and the whole system re-tones without a component being touched.

heading.$description: h1 to h3. One real tonal step above body.

body.$description: Running text and the surfaces it sits between.

heading-on-dark.$description: Heading text on an ink ground. The dark-theme counterpart of text.heading, bound by the --port-text-heading alias under [data-theme=dark].

body-on-dark.$description: Running text on an ink ground. The dark-theme counterpart of text.body.

secondary-on-dark.$description: Muted and meta on an ink ground (#99a1af). The dark-theme counterpart of text.secondary.

quote-on-dark.$description: Brighter muted text on an ink ground (white 78%): the endorsement-card quote, which stays brighter than the #99a1af meta. Reached via --port-text-quote.

status.$description: Status badges (the term sheet's Status fact). One tone per state; only shipped exists so far. A green fill, green text, and a green ring, all reading on either card ground.

shipped-bg.$description: Green highlight fill for a Shipped status.

shipped-fg.$description: Green text on the shipped fill.

card-on-dark.$description: Elevated card surface on an ink ground — one step lighter than the page, per the dark-mode base/elevated split (Apple HIG). The dark-theme counterpart of background.card.

ink.$description: Dark surfaces: mark card, splash, iPhone card.

utility.$description: Top utility bar on a light ground. On dark the bar is ink (background.ink) so it blends into the page; see component.topbar.bg-on-dark.

surface.$description: The glass system. Tint and pole are the ground; the fg pair is the foreground the glass carries, declared once per backdrop tone. Which of the two pairs is live is a runtime state, switched by [data-backdrop] in portfolio.css; the values are decided here.

btn-secondary.$description: Secondary (dark) button fill; the -30 variant is this at 30% via color-mix in portfolio.css.

glass-fg-on-light.$description: Glass foreground over a light backdrop.

glass-fg-on-dark.$description: Glass foreground over a dark backdrop.

glass-fill-on-light.$description: Glass background over a light backdrop.

glass-fill-on-dark.$description: Glass background over a dark backdrop.

glass-fill-opaque-on-light.$description: The opaque glass variant over a light backdrop: modals that must stay solid over content.

glass-fill-opaque-on-dark.$description: The opaque glass variant over a dark backdrop. Shared by the cookie, contact, and Ask-AI panels.

dither-tile.$description: Repeat size of the grain tile on every dithered surface.

bg.$description: Glass nav base tint, and the selection pill's fill.

bg-on-dark.$description: The selection pill over a dark backdrop: brighter, not darker, because the selected label stays dark.

type.$description: Typographic roles. Size, leading, tracking, and weight synthesis composed from the base scale.

docs-title-leading.$description: Line-height for the docs page title (the h1 under .ame-docs-root: case-study and /ame pages). The body/paragraph leading ratio (1.6, font.leading.loose) rather than the tight hero leading, so a wrapped title breathes like the running text does, proportionate to its larger size. Read by app/ame/ame.css.

heading-synthesis.$description: The live header weight synthesis. Every h1 to h3 on the surface is a stroked 400, not a 460 cut.

body-synthesis.$description: The live body weight synthesis, set on .portfolio-root.

icon-stroke.$description: Lucide icon stroke width, 1.5. The .lucide default rule in portfolio.css reads var(--type-icon-stroke) so every icon is 1.5 without a per-icon prop.

dense-leading.$description: Line-height for dense rows: the footer's stacked links and meta lines.

space.$description: Brand spacing decisions from the unit ramp.

motion.$description: Motion by role. Components reach for these, not raw durations or curves.

squish-duration.$description: The segmented-pill squish bounce (nav, 3D/2D toggle, accessibility Segmented).

card-duration.$description: The card hover transition (.port-card box-shadow + transform), 220ms.

enter-duration.$description: Entrance fades: the work-card enter animation and the case-study stagger, 520ms (snapped from 0.5s/0.6s onto the scale).

exit-ease.$description: Mobile menu and contact sheet close.

elevation.$description: Shadow recipes. Every colour is the ink at a graded alpha, referenced, so the whole shadow system re-tones from one primitive. Offset, blur, and spread are declared here: this file is their single home.

glass-edge.$description: The glass border, on its own so a surface can pick its strength without touching its drop. Every .port-glass surface carries one of these: the AI panel, the cookie modal, the nav, the top bar, the contact sheets. The default was doubled from 0.06 to 0.12 on 2026-07-29 so the edge reads against the page (D-23).

glass-edge-light.$description: The faint edge, for a surface that should stay quiet. The nav takes this one: it sits high on the page against plain paper, where the full edge reads as a hard outline.

glass-edge-on-dark.$description: The default edge over a dark backdrop. Doubled from 0.10 to 0.20 alongside the light tone, so both read at the same strength (D-23).

glass-edge-light-on-dark.$description: The faint edge over a dark backdrop.

glass-drop.$description: The glass drop, paired with any edge above.

pill-on-dark.$description: The nav pill over a dark backdrop: a slightly stronger edge and a deeper drop, because it sits on an opaque light fill against dark glass.
